newsitem.title: USA: FOB GULF GRAIN - SOYBEAN OFFERS MOSTLY LOWER.
newsitem.headline: FOB GULF GRAIN - SOYBEAN OFFERS MOSTLY LOWER.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers were mostly lower on Wednesday while corn values steadied.
One U.S. exporter cited the continued volatility of Chicago Board of Trade soybean futures which posted sharp gains on Wednesday's session.
Dealers also noted limited movement in both corn and soybeans.

On the export front, The Commodity Credit Corp said it bought 6,500 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat for donation to Armenia and 6,500 tonnes of U.S. HRW wheat for donation to Georgia.
South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd jointly bought 34,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Japanese trading house Nichimen Corp, traders said.
Iraq also bought 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat at $187 per tonne, including freight for delivery to Umm Qasr port.
